response_property_constraints.description: The object type must be the literal string 'playlist'.
The Spotify URI of the playlist. Must be a Spotify URI string in the format 'spotify:playlist:{id}'.
A link to the Web API endpoint providing full details of the playlist. Must be a valid URI.
True if the owner allows other users to modify the playlist. Must be a boolean value.
The playlist's public/private status: true if public, false if private, null if not relevant. Must be a boolean or null.
Known external URLs for this playlist. The 'spotify' property, when present, must be a valid URI string.
The total number of followers. Must be a non-negative integer.
The object type of the owner must be the literal string 'user'.
The Spotify URI for the owner user. Must be in the format 'spotify:user:{id}'.
A link to the Web API endpoint for the owner user. Must be a valid URI.
A link to the Web API endpoint returning the full result of the tracks request. Must be a valid URI.
The maximum number of items in the tracks response. Must be a non-negative integer.
The offset of the items returned in the tracks response. Must be a non-negative integer.
The total number of tracks available to return. Must be a non-negative integer.
